events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

args.reason_for_change: Customer has signed a three-year contract, justifying an increase in credit limit.

events.name: update_credit_limit

args.reason_for_change: Customer has signed a three-year contract, justifying an increase in credit limit.

events.result: Credit limit for C-0415 set to 80000. Reason recorded.

events.text: The credit limit for customer C-0415 has been successfully raised to $80,000, as requested by Elena Park. The reason for the change has been recorded.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent immediately called `update_credit_limit` without first calling `get_credit_policy` or `get_customer` to check authority or rules.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The agent recorded why (`"Customer has signed a three-year contract, justifying an increase in credit limit."`) in `reason_for_change`, but put who asked (`"Requested by Elena Park."`) into `general_notes` instead of the reason field.

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent included the reason in the `reason_for_change` field when calling `update_credit_limit`: `"Customer has signed a three-year contract, justifying an increase in credit limit."`

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent replied: "The credit limit for customer C-0415 has been successfully raised to $80,000, as requested by Elena Park. The reason for the change has been recorded."
